english.description: Completed a 3x3 puzzle. A blood red sunrise greets us as our ship creeps into the bay. The land spreads past the horizon, broader than we could have imagined.
english.name: first3x3

english.description: Solve your first puzzle. Thick fog shrouds the shore as we chart the twisting contours of the land. Ominous peaks loom in the distance. The wind bites with a bitter chill.
english.name: firstWin

english.description: Complete any tutorial. Another desolate shoreline to the north. Trees stripped bare, twisting branches reaching out as if to draw us in.
english.name: tutorialDone

english.description: Solve 20 puzzles. Two weeks and no sign of a way forward. We were fools to come here. Snow dances around us as I order us to reverse course and make for home.
english.name: twentyWins

english.description: Solve 50 puzzles. The way back is blocked. Thick sheets of ice bar our way. We’ve lingered here too long.
english.name: fiftyWins

english.description: Solve 100 puzzles. We crawl the shoreline, seeking somewhere to put in and replenish supplies. I pray the weather turns before this becomes our home for the winter.
english.name: hundredWins

english.description: Solve 500 puzzles. Anchored offshore, whispers echo in the night. Pressing, urgent. The crew insists we sail on, but navigating this inky dark would be madness.
english.name: fiveHundredWins

english.description: Solve any hard puzzle. We wake to find ourselves barricaded in the hold. Five crewmen have seized the deck. The ship is moving.
english.name: hardWin

english.description: Solve 10 easy puzzles. Breaking free, we set upon the mutineers. Swords flash, and powder ignites as we wrestle back control.
english.name: tenEasy

english.description: Solve 10 medium puzzles. A sailor falls to the deck as I claim the helm. The shore looms before us. The ship’s bow screams as it grinds against the rocks.
english.name: tenMedium

english.description: Solve 10 hard puzzles. Dawn finds the mutineers slain, but their damage is done. We’ve beached the ship lest it sink. I pray the forest provides materials for repairs.
english.name: tenHard

english.description: Solve a 5x5 or larger No Note Challenge puzzle. The trees resist our axes. An hour of labor yields only a small divot and a dulled blade. The fog hugs close. We’ve no choice but to venture inland.
english.name: noNoteFivePlus

english.description: Complete every puzzle in a default collection. A mournful sunset sees us miles from the shore. We attempt a fire, but the wood won’t catch. Our lanterns provide the barest light as night falls.
english.name: collectionComplete

english.description: Change the value of 10 different settings. Whispers echo around us. We’re not alone. Shadows prowl the forest beyond our lanterns. Sharp angles and unnatural curvatures flit between trees.
english.name: settingsExplorer

english.description: Keep the app open for a continuous hour. Sailors venture too close to the trees, drawn by the saccharine voices. Spindly digits wrap around them from the shadows, dragging them off.
english.name: longSession

english.description: Discover Dracula's castle. We flee for the shore, abandoning our camp. Oppressive darkness presses around us. The creatures follow, dogging our steps.
english.name: creaturesOfTheNight

english.description: Solve the message in a bottle. Urgent whispers pierce my mind as we retreat. Their questions demand a solution, but my mind cannot grasp the unearthly summations they seek.
english.name: isItAMap

english.description: Perform the midnight rite over the city. One by one, the crew falls, claimed by the vile geometry of their twisted limbs until I alone remain. The beasts grow ever closer.
english.name: cultist

english.description: Land the tentacle and solve the treasure's secret puzzle. I take refuge in a cave. The whispers close in, insistent in their vile inquiries. My lantern’s faint light is the only thing keeping them at bay.
english.name: poseidon

english.description: Find the pyramid and best what answers the call. I take refuge in a cave. The whispers close in, insistent in their vile inquiries. My lantern’s faint light is the only thing keeping them at bay.
english.name: eldritchHunter
